class_definitions.positive: NRI <hazard>_RISKV is numeric and greater than 0
class_definitions.zero: NRI <hazard>_RISKV is numeric and equal to 0
class_definitions.missing: NRI <hazard>_RISKV is null (the tract is in the source layer but has no value)
class_definitions.invalid: NRI <hazard>_RISKV is non-numeric, negative or not finite
class_definitions.overlay_positive: the tract has a DFIRM polygon with sfha_tf='T' and a summed area greater than 0 in the project's Summarize Within result
class_definitions.overlay_zero: the tract has DFIRM polygons but none with sfha_tf='T' (only 'F')
class_definitions.overlay_missing: the tract has no row in the project's group-by summary table
class_definitions.not_in_source: the universe (Census 2020 tracts for Hawaii) minus tracts present in the NRI layer; listed in census_only_tracts_not_evaluated.csv when the Census service was reachable

limits: The overlay row reads the project's own Summarize Within output; it was not recomputed here. The DFIRM input item and vintage are not recorded on the item (open in the project's QA note). The meaning of sfha_tf is taken from the layer's name and has not been checked against FEMA NFHL metadata in this run.
Modeled risk from a national dataset; not a hazard footprint, overlay or AFN measure.
FEMA terms for the NRI state it is for planning purposes only and not a substitute for localized risk assessment.
'zero' and the NRI rating labels are reported as the source gives them; their meaning has not been checked against the NRI technical documentation in this run.
Zero Census population and housing in 2020 describes the 2020 enumeration only; it does not establish zero need.
